Elansar.name: Elansar
Elansar.summary:
Elansar is a small myst like "point & click" adventure game
Explore an island and solve puzzles.
Will you uncover the Island's mystery ?

Record of Lodoss War.name: Record of Lodoss War
Record of Lodoss War.summary: Record of the Lodoss War is a hack and slash action dungeon crawler RPG, in a similar vein to Diablo. It is very loosely attached to the Japanese fantasy novels and anime series of the same name.
